title: Last Resort Survival

nodes.text: Last Resort Survival initiated

evidence.source_text: Last Resort Survival

nodes.text: Escape if you can using PPE and best option

evidence.source_text: Escape if you can. • Utilize all your Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and act immediately on your best option.

nodes.text: Drop gear to increase escape speed, keep fire shelter, hand tool, water, and radio if time allows

evidence.source_text: • Drop your gear to increase escape speed. Keep your fire shelter and, if time allows, your hand tool, water, and radio.

nodes.text: Use fire shelter as heat shield while moving

evidence.source_text: • You may be able to use the fire shelter for a heat shield as you move.

nodes.text: In light fuels, move through flames into the black

evidence.source_text: • In LIGHT FUELS, you may be able to move through the flames into the black.

nodes.text: If on the flank, try to get below the fire

evidence.source_text: • If you are on the flank of the fire, try to get below the fire.

nodes.text: Consider vehicles or helicopters for escape

evidence.source_text: • Consider vehicles or helicopters for escape.

nodes.text: Find a survivable area, stay out of hazardous terrain features

evidence.source_text: Find a survivable area. • Stay out of hazardous terrain features.

nodes.text: Use bodies of water

evidence.source_text: • Use bodies of water.

nodes.text: In light fuels, light an escape fire; in other fuels, light a backfire

evidence.source_text: • In LIGHT FUELS, you may be able to light an escape fire. In other fuels, you may be able to light a backfire.

nodes.text: Call for helicopter or retardant drops

evidence.source_text: • Call for helicopter or retardant drops.

nodes.text: Cut and scatter fuels if there is time

evidence.source_text: • Cut and scatter fuels if there is time.

nodes.text: Use available heat barriers like large rocks and dozer berms

evidence.source_text: • Use any available heat barriers such as large rocks and dozer berms.

nodes.text: Consider vehicle traffic hazards on roads

evidence.source_text: • Consider vehicle traffic hazards on roads.

nodes.text: Structures and vehicles may be an option for temporary refuge

evidence.source_text: • Structures and vehicles may be an option for temporary refuge.

nodes.text: Pick a fire shelter deployment site, maximize distance from surface fuels

evidence.source_text: Pick a fire shelter deployment site. • Your first priority is to maximize distance from nearest surface fuels.

nodes.text: Find the lowest point available

evidence.source_text: • Find the lowest point available.

nodes.text: Pick a surface that allows fire shelter to seal, remove ground fuels

evidence.source_text: • If possible, pick a surface that allows the fire shelter to seal, and remove ground fuels.

nodes.text: Get into fire shelter before flame front hits

evidence.source_text: • Get into the fire shelter before the flame front hits.

nodes.text: Position feet toward fire, hold down fire shelter

evidence.source_text: • Position your feet toward the fire and hold down the fire shelter.

nodes.text: Keep face pressed into ground, protect airway

evidence.source_text: • Keep your face pressed into the ground and protect your airway.

nodes.text: Deploy next to each other, keep talking

evidence.source_text: • Deploy next to each other and keep talking.

nodes.text: Expect extremely heavy ember showers

evidence.source_text: Expect: • Extremely heavy ember showers.

nodes.text: Expect superheated air blast before flame front

evidence.source_text: • Superheated air blast to hit before the flame front.

nodes.text: Expect noise and turbulent, powerful winds hitting fire shelter

evidence.source_text: • Noise and turbulent, powerful winds hitting the fire shelter.

nodes.text: Expect heat and fire glow inside fire shelter

evidence.source_text: • Heat and fire glow inside the fire shelter.

nodes.text: Expect long deployment times, when in doubt, wait it out

evidence.source_text: • Long deployment times…WHEN IN DOUBT, WAIT IT OUT.

nodes.text: Do not expect radio communication capabilities

evidence.source_text: • Do not expect radio communication capabilities.

nodes.text: Do not expect water or retardant from aerial resources

evidence.source_text: • Do not expect water or retardant from aerial resources.

nodes.text: Survival actions complete

evidence.source_text: NOTES
